DOP: abhivitarati pr. 3 sg. [abhi + vitarati], goes through, finds out for certain; is sure ; Vin I 134, 5 (āgantukā bhikkhū passanti āvāsike bhikkhū nānāsaṃvāsake, te samānasaṃvāsakadiṭṭhiṃ paṭilabhanti … te pucchanti pucchitvā nābhivitaranti anabhivitaritvā ekato uposathaṃ karonti, āpatti dukkaṭassa; cf Sp 1066, 2 : nābhivitarantī ti nānāsaṃvāsakabhāvaṃ maddituṃ abhibhavituṃ na sakkonti, taṃ diṭṭhiṃ na nissajjāpentī ti attho); — absol. abhivitaritvā, Vin III 73, 19 (sañciccā ti jānanto sañjānanto cecca ~itvā vītikkamo; Sp 437, 9 : ~itvā ti upakkamavasena maddanto nirāsaṅkacittaṃ pesetvā; Sp-ṭ [ Be ] II 251, 13 : ~itvā ti sanniṭṭhānaṃ katvā) ≠ II 91, 28 ; — neg. anabhivitaritvā, Vin I 134, 6 ; II 91, 31 .
CPD: abhi-vi-tarati , pr. 3 sg. [abhi + sa. vi + √tṛ], to come to an end; 3 pl. ~anti, Vin l 134, 5 (puc- chitvā nâbhivitaranti; Sp); abs. ~itvā; Vin ll 91, 28 ' (yaṃ jānanto sañjānanto cecca ~itvā vītikkamo); do. Vin lll 73, 19 ' (= 'sañcicca'; Sp: upakkamavasena maddanto nirāsaṃkacittaṃ pesetvā) = 112, 19 ' ( ex- abhi-vi-tarati sañjānantī cecca ~itvā vītikkamo, Vin lV 290, 27 ' ( = 'sañcicca'); neg. abs. an-°, Vin l 134, 7 ; ll 91, 31 .
NCP: pr. 3 sg. goes through, finds out for certain; is sure.

DOP: *abhiviññāpeti pr. 3 sg. [ of caus. of *abhi + vijānāti; cf S. abhivi√jñā and BHS vijñapayati], begs, entreats; solicits (from); induces (to do something) ; — aor. 3 sg. abhiviññāpesi, Vin III 18, 32 (purāṇadutiyikāya tikkhattuṃ methunaṃ dhammaṃ ~esi; cf Sp 213, 26 : purāṇadutiyikāyā ti bhummavacanaṃ, ~esī ti pavattesi, pavattanā pi hi kāyaviññatticopanato viññāpanā ti vuccati).
CPD: abhi-viññāpeti , pr. 3 sg. ( caus. of abhi + vi + √jñā), to cause to be manifest, to consummate ( acc ) ; aor. 3 sg. ~esi (purāṇadutiyikāya ( loc. ) tikkhattuṃ me- thunaṃ dhammaṃ), Vin lll 18, 32 (= pavattesi, Sp).
NCP: pr. 3 sg. | abhivi~n~naapeti begs, entreats; solicits (from); induces (to do something).

DOP: abhivinaye ind. [abhi + loc. of vinaya], as to the Vinaya ; as regards the discipline ; Vin I 64, 29 (abhidhamme vinetuṃ ~e vinetuṃ; Sp 990, 4 : ~e ti sakalavinayapiṭake vinetuṃ); M I 472, 5 (āraññaken’ āvuso bhikkhunā abhidhamme ~e yogo karaṇīyo); A V 24, 17 (abhidhamme ~e uḷārapāmujjo) ≠ Mil 344, 25 ; Sv 18, 17 (abhisaddo … paṭibalo vinetuṃ abhidhamme ~e ti ādisu paricchinne [dissati]); — see also abhidhamme.
NCP: ind. as to the Vinaya; as regards the discipline.
